name: The Black Shield
summary: Krog looks over the Blackened Iron Shield and sees nothing unusual about it. Krog suggests that the blacksmith Do'gol inspect it, though without much hope, and sends you to Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: A Second Opinion
sections.body: Krog sees nothing unusual about the shield. Do'gol, the blacksmith, might be able to tell more about it, Krog says, but warns against expecting much. Do'gol is in Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: Do'gol's Answer
sections.body: Do'gol calls it a good shield, strong and heavy. Do'gol has no need of it, though, being a maker of shields and not a buyer, and says you should know that.

faq.q: Who sends you to Do'gol with the shield?
aliases: who gives the black shield quest
where do i start the black shield
faq.answer: Krog, who looked over the Blackened Iron Shield and found nothing unusual about it.
Do'gol is the blacksmith in Brackenwall Village.

faq.q: Why does Krog send you to Do'gol?
aliases: why show the shield to the blacksmith
faq.answer: Krog hopes the blacksmith can tell more about the shield, though Krog does not expect much to come of it.

attribution: Classic quest text: The Black Shield
